tools.name: search_merchants
tools.description: Help dropshipping platforms research small, independent online retailers for merchant acquisition using the activated public dataset. Search by text, category and source sales-market label; market is not a business-location filter. Category accepts the English name from coverage, ignoring case, or i

tools.name: get_merchant
tools.description: Read one ID returned by search_merchants. Returns only data in the activated public dataset; not_ready is distinct from an unknown record.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Read public dataset status, published release information, English category names and counts. Use the returned category names for searching; their original Chinese aliases are also accepted. It does not describe the private commercial database or guarantee all categories are represented.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Explain how DropshippingLeads supports dropshipping platforms with small online retailer research, English category names and Chinese query aliases, cross-platform web discovery, the business-location collection focus, field meanings, data-use terms and MIT code-only licensing, provenance, unverifie

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_methodology · Private data: search_merchants, get_merchant, get_data_coverage · Public sink: get_methodology.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_methodology · Private data: search_merchants, get_merchant, get_data_coverage · Public sink: get_methodology

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
